thread:
keisha: Quick live thread following the runtime Q&A. Pulling together the little decisions we promised: public SLOs, fallback visibility, batching defaults, cache isolation, and kernel-v4 canary gates. Keep replies short.
owen: question about visibility: we said we'd signal fallbacks to customers. Can we do both a response header and a transient dashboard notice for affected orgs?
marco: header + dashboard is doable. Plan: X-Model-Fallback header (enum: none, quantized, smaller_model, degraded_features) + a 48h transient dashboard card linking to traces. Ops will gate dashboard surfacing behind an admin flag.
ting: batching decision: default to per-worker adaptive microbatching with a per-route opt-out via X-Request-Priority. Default config we discussed: mode=adaptive, max_batch_size=48, target_latency_ms=60. Spike circuit to prevent long queue buildup.
keisha: note: please make opt-out documented in onboarding docs so low-latency customers can pin. Also product asks for a small "explain" endpoint that can return why a request was batched (sampled).
owen: explain endpoint is cheap as a sampled proxy trace. We'll add a sampling flag to return batch_decision (batched=true/false, batch_size, queue_ms). Keep it internal but surface sanitized version in console.
marco: KV cache: per-tenant memory cap default 5% node mem, TTL default 5m, hot-score may extend TTL up to 4x but bounded by tenant cap. LRU with tenant fairness weights. We will run a 14-day canary on two clusters to measure hit-rate and cost delta.
ting: success criteria for the cache experiment: hit rate increase >8% on top routes and cost delta <7%. If both met, enable adaptive hot-extend. If memory >7% fleet-wide, auto-disable and alert infra.
keisha: kernel-v4 gating: we need numeric automation gates. Proposed: perf gate p95 regression <4% vs baseline on sampled traffic; memory gate resident <+6%; quality gate sampled-eval delta <1.0; determinism gate token-diff-rate <0.2% on 5k samples. Fail any gate -> auto rollback.
owen: timeline update: microbench suite done Monday. If green, stage-1 canary 10% (non-SLA) in 9 days, stage-2 50% two weeks later, full rollout conditional on gates. Marco will publish exact rollout playbook.
marco: will publish RFC with numeric gates + rollback steps by Wed. Also adding an explicit note that SLA customers are excluded from automatic quantize fallbacks unless they opt in.
ting: platform action items: 1) implement X-Model-Fallback header + X-Model-Fallback-Reason enum (platform). 2) add explain sampling to proxy (platform). 3) add route-level cache_hit_rate + eviction_rate to console backlog (platform).
ops-bot: Meeting notes uploaded: https://redwood.internal/notes/allhands-2851204820. :white_check_mark:
keisha: recap actions: marco RFC (marco), platform headers+explain (platform), infra run cache canary and report (owen), product blurb for release notes (keisha/product). Thanks all — will follow up with RFC links.
